author: eric29779
body:
Hi my name is eric29779 i got banned just today at 9/27/15 for Hacking-Aimbot
i know i already posted a appeal but just please take your time to read this one. I'm pretty sure this is a mistake because if you read my first ban appeal i promised to not hack and i kept it i was for sure not hacking when i was playing because i stopped hacking when i took my break from minecraft, Im really nervous right now and sad because i got banned a second time and you guys mine not accept this ban appeal so please take my word, i was not hacking. Thanks for taking your time to read this and i hope you can understand.

-eric29779
